items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-12-23
items.q: I used to go in, I don't call it, Hendrick Morton's place. I used to replace him. Hendrick Morton was working there... I used to replace him.

ctx.x: And when did the piano come into the line?

Well, the piano, well, I'll tell you about the piano. When they put a piano in the band, I mean, I couldn't get what the piano. You know, so used to playing just the bass and the guitar, you know, it was so nice, you know. I wasn't used to putting custom to it, you know what I mean? And I said, oh, this don't make sense, I mean, because we never had no piano in the band, you know. Pianos always played alone by themselves, you know. I remember the district, all the guys, you know, played mostly alone, you know.…
Would the piano be on the right or the left, though? How would it vary?
